title: Residency with Wood Kiln Access
source_quote: If you are interested in an extended stay as a working artist and/or wood kiln rental, please contact me for details.
evidence_sentence: The studio offers extended residencies for working artists with access to studio space and wood kiln rental, with rates available upon inquiry.
summary: Extended residencies (typically 3 days to 5+ weeks) available with studio access and option to arrange wood kiln firing. Rates vary; contact studio for details. Wood firing season usually April-October.
pay_text: Rates vary; contact studio for pricing details
how_to_join: Contact studio by phone (413-652-2492) or email (jzsedlock@gmail.com)
